# Golf Ball Drop 2027 · งานทิ้งลูกกอล์ฟการกุศล 2570

> Rotary Club of Chiang Mai International (CMIRC). Saturday 30 January 2027, 11:30-16:30, Horizon Village & Resort, 200 Moo 7, Chiang Mai-Doi Saket Road (Highway 118), Choeng Doi, Doi Saket, Chiang Mai 50220.

- A tethered hot-air balloon drops 300 numbered golf balls (1-300) at 15:00. The three balls closest to the X win.
- ฿1,000 a ball (2026 price). Winners need not be present.
- Prizes (2026): ฿30,000, ฿10,000 and ฿5,000 in gift vouchers of the winner's choice, valid internationally, not cash.
- On the day: Chiang Mai Expats Club picnic and BBQ from 11:30 (entry paid separately), children's balloon tent 12:00, tethered balloon rides 13:00-15:00 (adults ฿100, children ฿50).
- Money raised goes to the club's current and future children's projects: child safety, health and education in Northern Thailand (https://www.cmirotary.org/).
- Contact: NaN Peacock, fundraising chair, nan@motdang.net
- Page: https://nanobotco.github.io/golf-ball-drop/
